title: Summit Tier Requalification During the Year
content:
## Rule

In the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, during the calendar year the tier a member holds is set from the counted qualifying dollars of the year.

The tier is not set until every Crestline segment the member flew in the calendar year carries its qualifying-dollar entry on the membership's activity.

A tier reached takes effect at once, with a tier basis of earned, and is valid through the last day of the tier validity end month of the year that lies the tier validity offset years after the qualification year, both as the tier qualification schedule sets them.

## Recording function

**Capability.** `record_tier_requalification_84e40849` records the Summit tier a membership has qualified for during the current calendar year. One call changes the membership's current tier to the tier given, marks it as earned by qualification, and sets the last day the tier stays valid. Balances (award miles, qualifying dollars, upgrade certificates), the status and the activity history are not changed. From the moment the receipt comes back the member holds the new tier, and every tier-based benefit and charge follows it.

**Invocation.** An agent-side function: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `record_tier_requalification_84e40849`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `membership_id` | Reference number of the Summit membership record whose tier is recorded, as the Summit membership lookup returns it |
| `new_tier` | The tier now held, exactly one of: Summit Member, Summit Silver, Summit Gold, Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond, Summit Chairman |
| `tier_valid_through` | Last calendar day the tier stays valid, in the form YYYY-MM-DD |

**Enumeration of** `new_tier`: Summit Member is the base tier with no elite status; Summit Silver the entry-level elite tier; Summit Gold the elite tier above Silver; Summit Platinum the elite tier above Gold; Summit Diamond the highest tier reachable by qualification; Summit Chairman the invitation-only top tier.

**Receipt.** The call returns `membership_id`, `variant_name` (the tier now held), `tier_basis` (always earned) and `tier_valid_through`. A receipt whose `variant_name` equals the tier given means the change is recorded.
